projects.title: Closer than you think
projects.description:
London in Prishtina

Creative production of posters, postcards and questionnaires for British Airways' prize winning contest, depicting photographs of Prishtina city centre with London red buses, black cabs and other features from London.

 

 

'Ave a Cuppa

Design and development of an online game in the shape of interactive e-cards, promoting British Airways' special offers.

Users would design their cups, add milk and sugar, write a little note and send the cup of tea to friends and family. Winners of this online game received free return tickets to London.
